ai_summary_en: [Gemini Vision + 3D Trunk Cylinder & Ground Photo Referee] Multi-scale local DTM, strict 3D trunk cylinder slicing ('No Trunk = No Tree'), and 89 calibrated mobile phone photo projection(s) on 'RosePark_Merged2' verified 6 paved road & walkway corridor(s) (709.2 m² planar, excluding turf lawns & tree planters), 87 trunk-verified urban & park tree(s) (mean 1.3m breast-height DBH 21.9 cm via anti-webbing Pratt circle fit), 0 water bodies (dry urban/campus/park terrain), and 5 retaining/structural wall segment(s) (31.8 m² true 3D vertical face area).
